events.heading: 1855 - Charter
events.details: Charter now in effect signed by Governor Pollock, February 22; first Board of Trustees president, Judge Frederick Watts of Carlisle. Site in Centre County selected from nine offered throughout state; 200 acres donated by James Irvin with $10,000 pledge from citizens of Centre and Huntingdon counties.
events.imagealt: Propfile illustration of, James Pollock, Governor of Pennsylvania 1855-1858.

events.heading: 1856 - Construction of Old Main
events.details: Construction of Old Main (the &quot;College Building&quot;) begun; supervised by William G. Waring, who was appointed superintendent to open the school and plan farm, orchards and nursery.
events.imagealt: Black and white photo original Old Main in an empty field.

events.heading: 1874 - The Pennsylvania State College
events.details: School renamed The Pennsylvania State College.

events.heading: 1953 - The Pennsylvania State University
events.details: The Pennsylvania State University became official name.
